# Writing mathematical notation in quarto files

A quarto document can contain output from code chunks based on data, code and other technical content, including mathematical notation. $\LaTeX$ syntax is a well described system for writing mathematical notation, for example, in quarto files.


## Why use mathematical notation?

Similar to other written languages, mathematical notation helps you develop and communicate ideas. 


## Using $\LaTeX$ syntax in quarto documents

We can add inline mathematics using `$1 + 2 = 3$`, this will render to $1+2=3$. Using two `$` signs will put the equation on a new line.

`$$ 1 + 2 = 3$$` 

$$1+2=3$$
